about.title: Honest work, fair prices
paragraphs: John's Affordable Auto Repair is a Gresham shop built on honest, affordable work. We find the real problem, explain it in plain words and fix it for a fair price.
Customers bring us everything from small code checks and alternator replacements to rebuilt engines, and plenty come to us for a second opinion before paying for a big repair somewhere else.
about.photo_alt: Mechanic going over a repair with a customer

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and we will get back to you. Or call (503) 307-7802 (Mon–Fri: 8am–5pm; Sat: 9am–3pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! We will get back to you soon to set up a time.
